page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on KVM hypervisor technology, configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by 12 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 96.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio corresponding to 4.0 GB per vCPU. Cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1 data cache and 1 MB of L2 cache per core, along with 48 MB of shared L3 cache. Processor flag support features AVX-512 with VNNI extensions, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI hardware acceleration. The instance does not bundle local ephemeral storage or dedicated GPU devices, relying entirely on network-attached storage and providing a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmark results show solid baseline operational throughput across standard enterprise workloads. The CPU scores 1,860.89 in single-core stress-ng and 23,311.6 in multi-core stress-ng tests, alongside a overall PassMark CPU score of 28,868.06. Memory bandwidth measurements indicate 127.7 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 63.99 GB/sec for uncached writes. Database handling capability reaches 23.52 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks. In language processing tasks, text generation for a small 135M model achieves 294.62 tokens per second, placing in the upper quartile of tested systems, while medium 7B model generation reaches 13.1 tokens per second.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio offers balanced resource allocation suitable for standard computing workloads without overprovisioning RAM or compute capacity. The reliance on external block storage requires planning for remote disk attachments to meet persistent storage needs. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge fits web application serving, microservice backend clusters, software build pipelines, in-memory caching systems, and lightweight machine learning inference.
